children: Avici, a Solana-based banking service provider, said it has fully processed refunds after its hacking incident and added 10% cashback. According to Foresight News, card issuer partner Rain covered all refund costs.

The incident was limited to Solana card contract balances funded through Avici's deposit flow. Regular Avici Solana and EVM wallets were not affected, as they are self-custodial. EVM card balances, fiat deposits and withdrawals, and token swap functions were also unaffected. The related Solana contract has been upgraded, and no further abnormal activity has been found, with the team continuing to monitor the situation.
Foresight News previously reported that Avici was hacked yesterday and suffered losses of more than $600,000.

title: Avici Says Refunds Fully Processed After Solana Hack, Adds 10% Cashback
